% Minimal PGFPlots middle-axis geometry regression fixture.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\begin{document}
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{axis}[
      width=11cm,
      height=3.5cm,
      xmin=0,
      xmax=11*pi,
      ymin=-0.5,
      ymax=7.5,
      axis lines=middle,
      xtick=\empty,
      ytick=\empty
    ]
      \addplot coordinates {(0,0) (11*pi,7.5)};
    \end{axis}
  \end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
